title: Multimodal profiling uncovers an aging-associated ETS1-MYO1B vascular niche responsive to ipragliflozin.
summary: An ML age-clock combined with multimodal tissue and cell analyses identified an aging-associated ETS1-MYO1B vascular niche and examined its response to ipragliflozin in the reported models.
